title: Middle Eastern Crusted Pork Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by the cuisine of the Middle East, featuring a delicious crusted pork tagine.
instructions: Season the pork rib with salt, pepper, and ground cumin.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the pork rib until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork rib to a baking dish and top with crusted breadcrumbs.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the breadcrumbs are golden brown.
Meanwhile, prepare the tagine sauce by combining the chopped parsley, lemon juice, and olive oil in a small bowl.
Remove the pork rib from the oven and brush with the tagine sauce.
Return the pork rib to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
